action_items: (Minor) Fix hard-coded 'Total Potential (FY 25-26)' label on SchemesMaster header to interpolate the active season from useSeason() so it reads 'FY 2026-27' when 2026-27 is selected.
critical_code_review_comments: clone_season() in /app/backend/routes/reimbursement_schemes.py copied source documents verbatim, retaining the source's `id` field. Because reimbursement_schemes has a unique index on `id`, the very FIRST clone attempt to any target season threw pymongo.errors.DuplicateKeyError and returned HTTP 500 (blocking the entire new-season workflow in production). FIXED by regenerating uuid4 for each cloned doc's `id`. Recommend a regression test for this in the next sprint.
SchemesMaster header 'TOTAL POTENTIAL (FY 25-26)' label is not driven by the season context — cosmetic mismatch when a different season is active.

rca of the issue: clone_season bug — Source-of-truth: /app/backend/routes/reimbursement_schemes.py line ~198. `async for doc in db.reimbursement_schemes.find({'fiscal_cycle': from_cycle}, {'_id':0})` returned each doc INCLUDING its `id` UUID field (only `_id` was projected out). The subsequent upsert on (scheme_code, fiscal_cycle) created a NEW document (target season had 0 matches), but the copied `id` collided with the source-season's document because the collection has a unique index on `id`. Mitigation applied: assign `doc['id'] = str(uuid.uuid4())` right after mutating fiscal_cycle. Reproduction: POST /api/reimbursement-schemes/clone-season {from_cycle:'2026-27', to_cycle:'anything'} — 500 before fix, 200 after.
